enchantment.relicweave.keen_edge.desc: Increases melee damage dealt with Swords and Axes.
enchantment.relicweave.purling.desc: Press the Purling key to throw a conjured Ender Pearl, taking no teleport damage. No pearls required.
enchantment.relicweave.cobbled_up.desc: Mining stone has a chance to drop extra cobblestone.
enchantment.relicweave.oxidation.desc: Melee hits slow the target. At level III, they also weaken it.
enchantment.relicweave.conductive.desc: Increases mining speed. Incompatible with Efficiency.
enchantment.relicweave.golemed.desc: Adds armor and knockback resistance, like an Iron Golem.
enchantment.relicweave.piglinified.desc: Piglins treat you as if you were wearing gold.
enchantment.relicweave.villagers_best_fr: Villagers give you Hero of the Village discounts.
enchantment.relicweave.the_necromancer.d: Slain monsters may rise as a Husk that fights for you for 30 seconds.
enchantment.relicweave.necromanced.desc: Undead ignore you unless you attack them. Grants immunity to Wither.
enchantment.relicweave.upbound.desc: Press Jump in mid-air to jump again, once per level.
item.relicweave.diamond_totem.save: On death: survive with 4 health, Resistance II and Regeneration II
item.relicweave.netherite_totem.save: On death: survive at half health, gain protective effects, and repel nearby mobs
item.relicweave.ultra_totem.passive: Passive: +8 Max Health, Fire Resistance, Regeneration
item.relicweave.ultra_totem.save: On death: fully heal, cleanse harmful effects, and gain powerful buffs
tooltip.relicweave.totem.offhand: Works from your offhand. Never consumed.
tooltip.relicweave.totem.either_hand: Works from either hand. Never consumed.

How to use the

and the

§2§lTransmutation
Table§r

§lTop-left:§r
 material
§lBottom-left:§r
 catalyst

§2§lUsing the Books§r

Put the book and
your item in an
§lanvil§r.

Two books of the
same level combine
into the next level.
book.relicweave.guide.page8:
§3§lCelestial§r

Mine §bCelestial Ore§r
in the End (rarer
in the Nether).

4 Shards + 1
Netherite Ingot =
§bCelestial Ingot§r

Upgrade Netherite
gear with it at a
Smithing Table.

book.relicweave.guide.page10:
§3§lUsing the Infuser§r

§lTop-left:§r
 Celestial armor
§lBottom-left:§r
 infusion material

When the arrow is
full, take the armor
from the right slot.

Only Celestial
armor works.
book.relicweave.guide.page11:
§3§lInfusion Rules§r

Each armor piece
holds up to §l3§r
different
infusions.

Attribute infusions
fit any piece and
stack on several.
Effect infusions
(page 18) fit one
piece and never
stack.

jei.relicweave.info.transmutation_table: Turns a material and a catalyst into an enchanted book. Put the material in the top-left slot and the catalyst in the bottom-left slot. When the arrow fills, take the book from the right slot. Ingredients are used only when the book is made. Apply books at an anvil, and combine two of the same level to level up.
jei.relicweave.info.celestial_infuser: Adds an infusion to Celestial armor. Put a Celestial armor piece in the top-left slot and an infusion material in the bottom-left slot. When the arrow fills, take the armor from the right slot. Each piece holds up to 3 different infusions, and only Celestial armor is accepted.
jei.relicweave.info.celestial_ore: Celestial Ore generates in End Stone in the End, and more rarely in Netherrack in the Nether. Mine it with a diamond pickaxe or better to get Celestial Shards (Fortune increases the drop). 4 Celestial Shards + 1 Netherite Ingot make a Celestial Ingot.
jei.relicweave.info.celestial_armor: Made by upgrading Netherite armor with a Celestial Ingot at a Smithing Table. Celestial armor can be infused at a Celestial Infuser: up to 3 different infusions per piece, each adding a bonus.

book.relicweave.guide.page18:
§3§lEffect Infusions§r

§lTidal§r (helmet):
 water breathing
 underwater.
§lWarding§r (chest):
 softens next hit,
 20 s recharge.
§lPursuit§r (legs):
 speed on a kill.
§lAnchored§r (boots):
 crouch: 75% less
 knockback.
book.relicweave.guide.page19:
§2§lEnchantments 1/2§r

§lReaping§r I-III, hoe:
 harvests, replants
 mature crops near.
§lUndertow§r I-III,
trident: slows
 targets in water.
§lResonance§r I-III,
pickaxe: faster on
 the same block,
 max +10%/level.
 No Conductive.
book.relicweave.guide.page20:
§2§lEnchantments 2/2§r

§lSoulguard§r I-II,
chestplate: small
 absorption shield
 after a kill.
§lSteady Draw§r I-II,
bow: walk faster
 while drawing.
§lReprisal§r I-III,
shield: block just
 after raising it

book.relicweave.guide.page21:
§6§lRelics 1/3§r

One of each type
counts, as charms.

§lLodestone Charm§r
 Toggle: pulls
 nearby drops in.
§lTidal Charm§r
 Water breathing,
 clearer water.
§lFeatherwoven§r
 Half fall damage,
 slow falling.
book.relicweave.guide.page22:
§6§lRelics 2/3§r

§lWayfarer's Relic§r
 Sneak + use: bind
 a spot. Activate:
 channel 3 s, then
 return there.
 Same dimension
 only. Moving or
 damage cancels.
§lEcho Charm§r
 Activate: nearby
 hostile mobs glow
 for 10 s.
book.relicweave.guide.page23:
§6§lRelics 3/3§r

§lGuardian Relic§r
 When a hit leaves
 you at 3 hearts
 or less, gain a
 short absorption
 shield. It cannot
 stop a lethal hit.

Cooldowns stay
through death,
relogging and
swapping items.
book.relicweave.guide.page24:
§lControls§r

§lR§r: Activate Relic
§lG§r: Cycle Relic
§lV§r: Purling

Rebind them in
Options > Controls
> Key Binds >
RelicWeave.

Curios adds a
charm slot.
